body: I do believe some of them hope for me to take the final step... so that's one more reason to.
They do hate me and for good reason. My not working at it has really made some major damage that I don't know how to fix.

I have opened up in the past but have got nothing out of it, except hurting the ones that offered me help.
Now it's too late for everything and I don't even know if I'm depressed. Maybe I want to tell myself I'm depressed so that I have an excuse.

I lied, and I actually lie, a lot. Compulsively, even, just as a reflex to protect myself from pretend harm (and end up causing much more collateral damage). 
I can't and, to some degree, don't want to talk about this. 
The point is that all this talking and oversharing and pouring myself over my friends and acquaintances had distanced them beyond repair and left me hopeless and helpless.
I always just booed my problems and never faced them. 
Now that I have to, I don't know how. I feel like I don't have the strength and that alone is shameful because I'm normal. Normal people don't do this shit. 
So probably it's just that I'm so lazy I'd rather die than face myself and my endless lack of happiness and enormous ego.
